note: In-browser AI on top of smart taps: after the page is idle a worker loads Transformers.js + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (q8, ~23 MB model + 14 MB runtime, cached). Menu choices get a 0-0.2 bonus from similarity to your recent picks and typed calls. Press / or the ›_ button to type a call: near misses like teo.folds(surgical) map to the nearest real function (auto-applied with undo when confident, otherwise 'did you mean' chips). Chrome's built-in model adds a ✨ suggestion for free text where available. ?noai=1 turns it off.
